title: New Time-Domain Preconditioners for HB Jacobian of RF Circuits
problem: Harmonic balance (HB) Jacobian solving in RF circuit simulation requires efficient linear system solvers that balance computational cost with reduction in Newton iterations, especially for strongly nonlinear circuits.
motivation: Existing time-domain preconditioners cannot simultaneously achieve efficient linear solver performance and iteration reduction for highly nonlinear RF circuits.
method: Proposes novel time-domain preconditioners for HB Jacobian that address both linear solver efficiency and iteration step reduction. Extends preconditioning to distributed device circuits via a new approach. Introduces matrix norm-based nonlinearity metric for a priori preconditioner selection.
key_novelty: First time-domain preconditioner design that balances linear solver efficiency with iteration reduction for nonlinear RF circuits.
contributions: Novel time-domain preconditioner for HB Jacobian with improved efficiency and convergence
Extension of preconditioning to circuits with distributed devices
Matrix norm-based metric for a priori circuit nonlinearity assessment and preconditioner selection
primary_theme: Efficient preconditioners for RF circuit Jacobian solving
